title: Swap a Shift
callout: Digital shift swaps — no more phone tag

shots.say: Need to swap a shift? Here's how. No phone calls required.
shots.caption: Swap a shift, no phone calls

shots.say: Option one: hand your seat to somebody. Tap your shift on the schedule, then Give up this shift.
shots.caption: Your shift → Give up this shift

shots.say: Choose Offer it to someone specific.
shots.caption: Offer it to someone specific

shots.say: This list has already dropped anyone who couldn't take it: people already on the shift, on approved leave, not cleared for your seat, or working a shift right next to this one. Fewest shifts that month comes first.
shots.caption: Only people who can actually take it

shots.say: Pick someone and send the offer. They get Take the shift or Decline. If they take it, that's it. No officer needed.
shots.caption: They tap Take the shift. Done.

shots.say: Until they answer, the shift is still yours, and nobody else can claim it. You can withdraw the offer any time.
shots.caption: Still yours until they accept

shots.say: Option two: on My Shifts, tap Swap on your shift.
shots.caption: My Shifts → Swap

shots.say: Specific Shift asks to move you to another shift you pick.
shots.caption: Specific Shift: move to another shift

shots.say: Open Swap offers your seat to members who are cleared for it. It stays yours until one of them picks it up.
shots.caption: Open Swap: any cleared member can pick it up

shots.say: Exchange With a Member is a real trade. You take their seat, they take yours, and it only lists swaps you're both cleared for.
shots.caption: Exchange: trade seats with a member

shots.say: Submit the request. An exchange goes to a duty officer, and never one who's part of the swap. Anything still unanswered the day before the shift is closed automatically, and you're told.
shots.caption: An officer outside the swap signs off

shots.say: Digital shift swaps. No more phone tag.
shots.caption: No more phone tag
